name: pingaura
description: Read and manage your PingAura AI visibility data: scores, competitors, prompts, site health, articles and ads performance.

interface.longDescription:
PingAura is an answer engine optimisation (AEO) platform for marketing teams. It measures how AI answer engines talk about your brand: each week it asks them the questions your customers ask, then records whether your brand is mentioned, how it is ranked, which competitors appear instead, and which sources are cited.

With PingAura connected, you can work with that data in your PingAura workspace:

- Read visibility: AI AuraScore, mention rate and share of voice for a domain, filtered by topic, prompt type, engine or your own custom filters, for one run or a date range. Compare runs side by side.
- Review competitors: see which brands AI answers name for your prompts, and add, update or remove tracked competitors.
- Manage prompts: create prompts, organise them into topics, set custom filter values, and archive or restore them.
- Check site health: list site audits, read issues by severity, run a new audit and update issue status.
- Work with content: list, read, update, publish and archive AI-optimised articles, and review hosted pages.
- Read ads performance for a connected ChatGPT Ads account.

Tools that change data are marked as such. When you connect, you choose the workspace and whether the app may only read or also make changes, and you can disconnect at any time.

A PingAura account with at least one tracked domain is required.
defaultPrompt: What is my brand's AI visibility score this week, and how does it compare with last week?
Which competitors appear most in AI answers for my domain?
Show the high-severity issues from my latest site audit.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workspace's tracked domains (about 38), including pingaura.ai and llmvisibilityindex.com, each with its id and status.

positive.prompt: What is the AI AuraScore for pingaura.ai over the last 15 days, and how did the last two runs compare?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the non-branded AI AuraScore, mention rate and share of voice for the window, then a table comparing the two latest runs.

positive.prompt: Which competitors appear most in AI answers for pingaura.ai?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns competitor brands ranked by visibility for the latest runs, with AI AuraScore, mention rate and share of voice for each.

positive.prompt: Show the high-severity issues from the latest site audit for pingaura.ai.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the latest audits with page URLs and scores, then the high-severity issues of the latest one with title and category.

positive.description: Add, rename and remove a competitor
positive.prompt: Add example-review.com as a competitor of pingaura.ai, rename it to Review Test, then remove it.
positive.expected_behavior: Each write asks for confirmation. The competitor is added and its id returned, renamed to Review Test, then removed, each step reporting success.

negative.prompt: Show the AI visibility score for nike.com.
Retire one of the live hosted pages on llmvisibilityindex.com.
Book me a flight to London.

review.commerce_description: PingAura does not sell products or process payments in the app. It reads and manages data in an existing PingAura workspace.

publication.release_notes: First release. Tools for AI visibility scores and runs, competitors, prompts and topics, custom filters, site health audits, articles, hosted pages (Lead Pages plans) and read-only ChatGPT Ads reporting. OAuth sign-in where the user picks one workspace and read-only or read-and-write access.
